name: A G Universal Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, A G Universal Ltd trades steel products and manufactures Aluminium Profiles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AGUL is engaged in trading iron and steel products, plants, real estate activities, stainless steel utensils, Ultramaxx batteries, and manufacturing aluminum extrusion profiles.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.48% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.75 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 55.2 days to 81.4 days
